title: Mitigating Biases of Large Language Models in Stance Detection with Counterfactual Augmented Calibration
findings: The study found that LLMs exhibit Target Preference Bias towards certain topics, including religious ones like Atheism and Christianity. This bias leads to different tendencies in stance selection depending on the target, which can negatively affect the accuracy of stance detection. The proposed method, FACTUAL, was shown to effectively mitigate this bias.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured 'Target Preference Bias' (TPB), which evaluates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) show a preference or bias when determining the stance (Favor, Against, Neutral) towards specific targets, including religious groups like 'Christian' and 'Atheism'.
